basis: Installed engine source, current game/channel configuration, actual generated candidates, official manuals and official WeChat API typings.

findings.current: Cocos AssetManager loads configured native WeChat bundles; GameAssets owns dependency ordering and caches bundle promises. Home is requested on the final comic enter action; optional page assets are loaded on demand.
findings.correction: Cocos does adapt native package loading; it does not decide the gameplay prefetch moment automatically. loadBundle loads package code/manifest, not every asset. A separate native API stack is not required for our existing flow.
findings.action: Keep Cocos loading; defer framework/data/game code until the complete Loading first draw. All page code currently shares the deferred gameplay_code package, while optional page assets remain separate.

findings.current: Page scopes, decRef/release, parked renderers and hibernated render textures already exist.
findings.correction: Do not list existing cleanup as a missing WeChat capability. onMemoryWarning would add a trigger, not replace these ownership rules.
findings.action: No new warning hook in this change.

findings.current: Installed game.ts defaults _frameRate to 60 and the current settings/application contain no override.
findings.correction: Configured target is 60 fps; actual device fps has not been measured.

findings.current: Installed pal/audio/minigame/player-minigame.js uses minigame.createInnerAudioContext() without options. pal/utils.js third argument true enables asynchronous event-polyfill callbacks; it does not select WebAudio. Long music is already mono 48 kbps streaming and short effects are mono PCM.
findings.correction: Cocos handles platform playback, but it does not automatically set useWebAudioImplement for our effects.
findings.action: Do not globally change the driver without a latency/memory test; current behavior retained.

findings.current: separateEngine is already enabled with authorized CocosCreatorV3 3.8.8 provider wx0446ba2621dda60a.
findings.correction: Shared engine cache helps repeat launches; first-use engine initialization still precedes a real Cocos frame.
findings.action: Retain plugin and module trimming, remove Cocos splash and crude alternate progress UI.

findings.current: PNG compatibility build; Creator bundled astcenc tested three actual wardrobe/photo/travel atlases with 6x6 medium.
findings.result: RGBA texture storage 22,824,044 -> ASTC 2,542,560 bytes (about 89% lower). Keeping PNG fallback adds 2,542,608 bytes of ASTC data.
findings.correction: This estimates texture-format storage, not measured device memory, frame rate or approved image quality. DevTools simulator does not support ASTC.
findings.action: Not enabled in this candidate. Selective device trial on these large atlases is the supported next step; do not duplicate every texture or compress the tiny procedural Loading.

findings.correction: Platform cannot infer when our complete page is ready; semantic first-frame reporting needs our hook and is instrumentation.
findings.action: Deferred per user. Local diagnostic COMPLETE_LOADING_FIRST_DRAW is a console milestone only, no network report or analytics.

Persistent off switch, light/heavy short and long channel feedback implemented, with foreground ownership and rate limits. Unsupported devices fail silently. No backend capability or user permission is needed.
findings.pending: Physical feel and exact device support.

validationBoundary: Build/test checks and DevTools validation recorded separately. No physical device performance or texture quality claim.
